title: Task Manager
text: Create and manage task executions in Simulink model, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Specify task duration via} sets Source of task execution time; {Enable task simulation} enables simulation of task duration, {List of tasks}, {Add}, {Delete}, {Use Schedule Editor ordering} sets the task priority using Schedule Editor tool, {Name}, {Type} sets the trigger type, {Period} sets the timer period, {Core} sets the processor core to execute task, {Priority}, {Drop tasks that overrun}, {Play recorded task execution sequence} enables playback from file, {Percent} sets the likelihood of distribution, {Mean}, {SD} sets the standard deviation of task duration, {Min} sets the lower limit of task, {Max} sets the upper limit of task and {File name} sets the file containing diagnostic scheduling data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable task simulation
params.values: Enable simulation of task duration on (default) | off

params.name: Use Schedule Editor ordering
params.values: Specify task priority using Schedule Editor tool off (default) | on

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of task Task1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Type
params.values: Trigger type of task Timer-driven (default) | Event-driven

params.name: Core
params.values: Processor core to execute task 0 (default) | non-negative integer | -1

params.name: Priority
params.values: Priority of task in scheduler 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Drop tasks that overrun
params.values: Drop tasks that overrun off (default) | on

params.name: Play recorded task execution sequence
params.values: Enable playback from file off (default) | on

params.name: Specify task duration via
params.values: Source of task execution time Dialog (default) | Input port | Record task execution statistics

params.name: Mean
params.values: Mean task duration in simulation 1e-06 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: SD
params.values: Standard deviation of task duration in simulation 0 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Min
params.values: Lower limit of task duration 1e-06 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Max
params.values: Upper limit of task duration 1e-06 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: File name
params.values: File containing diagnostic scheduling data filepath
